create_freeze_transformation: create a freeze transformation that zeros out gradient updates for parameters matching a boolean mask
create_selective_transform: create a selective transform that routes optimizer updates only to unfrozen parameters while freezing others
freeze_parameters_with_mask: freeze specific model parameters by passing a boolean pytree mask to the freeze transformation
selective_transform_with_adam: selective transform an adam optimizer with a freeze mask to train only unfrozen parameter leaves
freeze_all_parameters: freeze all model parameters by passing a single True boolean to the freeze transformation
